title: FHFA House Price Index — Monthly Index (July 2026 data)
source: EST: fhfa.gov/data/hpi fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes), the agency's own "FHFA HPI Release Dates" table, whose "2026 HPI Release Dates" block reads "Tuesday, September 29 | Monthly Index | July 2026". Independently corroborated in prose by the published 2026Q2 report (released 2026-08-25), whose Notes state FHFA will release "the next monthly HPI report (including data through July 2026) on September 29, 2026" -- as read and quoted by the fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24 lane on 2026-09-06. Filed estimate per the lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. No release time is stated on the primary and none is claimed here. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2026-10-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). This is the IMMEDIATE PREDECESSOR edition of the proposer -- the July-data monthly, 28 days ahead of the proposer's August-data monthly -- and it is the print that sets the base the proposer will be measured against, because at D-51 no August consensus exists and none can before this edition lands. The calendar's FHFA coverage currently starts at fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24 with fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 proposed behind it, so the two 2026 editions BEFORE the quarterly one (09-29 and the proposer's 10-27) were both invisible on the board; the proposer's own canonical file closes half that gap and this closes the other half. Unlike the proposer it is NOT an FOMC day: the September FOMC is 15-16 and the October meeting is 27-28 (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched 2026-09-06), which makes 09-29 the cleanest FHFA slot in the corridor and the better baseline reading of the two. It does share its slot with consumer-confidence-2026-09-29, already tracked -- the Conference Board publishes at 10:00 ET on the last Tuesday of every month, so all 68 measured FHFA release days since 2021 are also Consumer Confidence days. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06), FHFA HPI appears on neither sheet of the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx, and the proposer measured a well-powered null across 36 permutation tests.
